description:
Decided in 'What must docs/verdict.md contain to count as done?' (defk-dtw.4): the devex bar needs a cold test. Run a fresh agent session that gets only README.md, docs/language.md and the error output (no lib/ source, no prior context) and asks it to write a kernel for a job not in the catalog: a count-min sketch update_many over [u64] hashes (NIF survey category 3, expansion-adjacent). Record the full log: every compile error it hit, whether the error's hint got it unstuck, and whether the final kernel agrees with Elixir mode (assert_agrees).

Each error that didn't help is a bug on defk-vku's format or a missing docs/language.md entry: fix or ticket it, then rerun. Done when a run completes the kernel from the docs alone and the log is in docs/verdict.md's Developer experience section.
title: Devex cold test: a new kernel from the docs alone
